svg.title: ameura-little-nemaha-496317 - original atlas schematic
svg.desc: Original educational schematic; not a photograph or exact reconstruction. Reused original generalized trilobite geometry, not a scan of the southeastern Nebraska specimen or a reconstruction diagnosing A. missouriensis. The Gzhelian age envelope does not date this individual exactly to 300 Ma or establish continuous existence.
